about_the_game:
This is a life simulation game with elements of horror and psychological suspense.

Story:
To save money, You rented an unusually cheap apartment. But soon after moving in, you began to notice strange things happening every night. What started as small, seemingly insignificant anomalies slowly grew into an inescapable sense of dread.

This place… it feels like something terrible once happened here.

Features:

  • Life simulation gameplay: each night, you’ll engage in ordinary activities like eating, showering, and using the bathroom.

  • No complex controls or puzzles — the horror unfolds naturally around you.

  • Discover the apartment’s dark history through disturbing events.

  • Your actions and choices will lead to different endings.

  • The game has an approximate playtime of around 1 hour.
